coverLetter: I'm excited to apply for the Software Engineer position at Deel. With 7+ years building scalable SaaS applications and deep expertise in TypeScript and React.js, I'm eager to contribute to the platform that's transforming global work.

• TypeScript & React Expertise: I've built production applications using React with functional components, React Hooks, and Redux state management. At EncodeBiz, I delivered a tournament management SaaS with React/TypeScript, integrating with Node.js backends and writing comprehensive tests with React Testing Library.

• SaaS & FinTech Experience: At Delfín Motor Labs, I integrated Stripe payments for an e-commerce SaaS platform, handling secure payment flows and webhook events. At First Due (Inc 5000), I developed multi-tenant SaaS features for 40+ enterprise clients, experiencing rapid company growth from 50 to 150+ employees.

• Remote-First Culture: I've thrived in distributed teams across US, Spain, Panama, and LATAM for 4+ years. I understand the unique challenges of async communication, cross-timezone collaboration, and maintaining team camaraderie remotely.

• Full-Stack Capabilities: While frontend-focused, I have solid Node.js/Express backend experience. I've designed REST APIs, worked with PostgreSQL and Redis, and deployed to AWS S3 and VPS infrastructure.

Deel's mission to unlock global opportunity resonates deeply with me. As someone who has worked remotely across multiple countries and timezones, I've experienced firsthand the challenges your platform solves. I'm passionate about building products that enable the future of work.
I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to Deel's continued growth and success.
